outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Chelsea FC 2.74 vs Manchester United FC 1.57, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: Chelsea FC at home: 2W-1D-1L, 11 scored and 8 conceded in 4 games.
Manchester United FC away: 0W-3D-1L, 4 scored and 6 conceded in 4 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.51 goals per game, away teams 1.26.
Recent league form (newest first): Chelsea FC LWWLD, Manchester United FC LDDDL (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: Chelsea FC has 4 home games and Manchester United FC 4 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
